purpose: More conservative record-level evidence screen after identifying uncontextualized AC50-heavy future records.

A_affinity_candidate.definition: Exact (=), numeric, molar-unit Ki or Kd record.
A_affinity_candidate.training_role: high-weight candidate only; assay metadata/original paper required before saying direct binding

B_quantitative_functional_candidate.definition: Exact (=), numeric, molar-unit IC50 or EC50 record.
B_quantitative_functional_candidate.training_role: weighted functional positive candidate; not direct-binding evidence

C_contextual_functional_exact.definition: Exact functional-effect record such as Inhibition, Activity, Emax, or Efficacy.
C_contextual_functional_exact.training_role: sensitivity/context only; exclude from the primary label set pending assay review

Q_unverified_screen_or_other_exact.definition: Exact AC50/Potency record, an exact endpoint with missing molar semantics, or an unclassified exact endpoint.
Q_unverified_screen_or_other_exact.training_role: quarantine; not a primary or weighted positive until ChEMBL/primary-source assay context is checked

D_censored_or_unresolved.definition: Any non-exact relation, missing value, or non-numeric measurement.
D_censored_or_unresolved.training_role: neither positive nor assumed negative in PU learning
